answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 16894 Country: KE Title: Asalamualaykum,how is the vomit of a 2 month old baby girl or boy considered.Meaning clean or najis.If najis then how to clean.Shukran. Question: Asalamualaykum,how is the vomit of a 2 month old baby girl or boy considered.Meaning clean or najis.If najis then how to clean.Shukran. Answer ID: 16894 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1620/1620/M=1430) The vomit of a two month old baby girl or boy is najis as it is mentioned in Al-Durr al-Mukhtar: وهو نجس مغلظ ولو من صبي ساعة ارتضاعه هو الصحيح لمخالطة النجاسة ذكره الحلبي It will be cleaned in the same way as other unclean things are cleaned i.e. by washing and cleaning etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
